verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI-planned task graphs that run on autopilot, where blocked steps resume once their dependencies clear. That is internal workflow sequencing. No source documents user-defined rules that fire actions when external events occur. The autonomous-versus-supervised boundary control and the mention of KPI alerts are adjacent features, not an event-trigger rule system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
